- Titel: Brief von Lotte Zweig an Eva; Mayer, Ursula Altmann [21. Juli 1940], SZ-AAL/B1.34
- Signatur: SZ-AAL/B1.34
- Datum: 21.7.1940
- Objekttyp: Brief
- Umfang: 5 Scans

pages.transcription:
c/o Viking Press
18 East 48th street
New York. 21.7.40
Dear children,
You cannot
imagine what a strange
feeling it is to be so
long without news from
one's family, and I
very much hope that you
have all sat down and
written us long letters as
soon as you had received
the cable that we would
stay here a little longer.
We want of course to know
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief auf blauem Papier. Seite 1.

pages.transcription:
about everything - about
school, about the house,
the garden, the fowls,
your flowerbeds, your
friends - and of course about
the prospects of Eva's coming.
And what's about swimming,
tennis, the farm next door
Levinthal's and the piano?
And William? You see, I
make it very easy for
you. You have just to answer
my questions one after the
other and you will have
written me a long letter.
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief auf blauem Papier. Seite 2.

pages.transcription:
And where are your parents
Ursula? And Mummy and
Daddy, Eva? I have not
heard from them yet so
you must tell them me all
about them.
We are quite all-right
here in New York although
it is very hot and every-
body is complaining. But
as nearly all the shops and
restaurants are now air-
conditioned - that means cooled
like a refrigerator - it is not
too bad and we still walk
long distances as if we were
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief auf blauem Papier. Seite 3.

pages.transcription:
still at Bath. It is strange
to see all the lights in
the evening, and not to think
about the blackout, and
also to hear sirens all the
time. It always reminds
me of home when I see those
things and I hope from all
my heart that you did'nt hear
any sirens yet and never will
while the war lasts.
Uncle Stefan sends you
his love. He will write you
as soon as he gets your first
letters.
Kindest regards to all
and kisses to both of you,
Auntie Lotte

[Randtext, vertikal geschrieben:]
Kindest regards to you all! do you know 96 degrees
of heat are like? Not so bad as I was afraid. Only
aunt Lotte complains and I have to buy
ice
creams
in an
aircon-
ditioned
cafeteria.
Love
Stefan
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief auf blauem Papier. Seite 4 mit Randtext.
Farbskala/Grauskala fuer Archivierung. Teilweise ist der Text von Seite 4 durch das Papier sichtbar.
